description: A VideoAnalyzer Agent that autonomously processes and acts on data inputs using video recognition tools to interpret content, identify objects/actions/patterns; combined with web browsers for real-time internet retrieval—enabling surveillance, content moderation, automated tagging, insight extraction from streams, and correlation with online resources in dynamic workflows.

tools.name: VideoRecognitionAPI
tools.description: An API that processes video inputs to recognize and categorize visual content.

tools.name: ObjectDetectionModel
tools.description: A model that identifies and locates objects within video frames.

tools.name: ActionRecognitionModel
tools.description: A model designed to analyze and interpret actions occurring within video content.

tools.name: WebBrowser
tools.description: A tool that allows the agent to access and retrieve real-time information from the internet.

tools.name: DataStorage
tools.description: A system for storing processed data, insights, and metadata for future reference.

tools.name: RealTimeStreamingAPI
tools.description: An API that facilitates the processing of live video streams for immediate analysis.

tools.name: ContentModerationTool
tools.description: A tool that helps in filtering and moderating content based on predefined guidelines.

tools.name: AutomatedTaggingSystem
tools.description: A system that automatically generates tags for video content based on recognized elements.

tools.name: InsightExtractionTool
tools.description: A tool that extracts meaningful insights from video content and associated data.

tools.name: CorrelationEngine
tools.description: An engine that correlates video data with online resources for enhanced context and understanding.
